fusions.name: Gnawed Edges
fusions.desc: A strike that needs one of your afflictions on the target and devours it, dealing 8 damage and leaving the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Plague Scroll
fusions.desc: Unrolls a plague scroll whose swarm deals 26 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles, plus 4% of a boss or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Chewing Cloud
fusions.desc: Releases a cloud of chewing paper locusts for 10 seconds that bites an enemy within 4 tiles for 3 damage every second.

fusions.name: Famine Edition
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you heal for 15% of the damage you deal for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
